content: 2026 consensus for React accessible modals: native <dialog> element via ref.showModal() is the recommended default — built-in focus trap, Escape-to-close, ::backdrop, top-layer stacking, correct ARIA semantics, Baseline since 2022, zero extra dependencies. Caveat: must imperatively call showModal()/close(), conditional JSX rendering alone doesn't open it. React 19 allows passing ref as a plain prop without forwardRef, simplifying wrapping the native element in a component.
